en.t: Conquest of Southern Yan by Jin
en.s: The Conquest of Southern Yan by Jin, also known as Liu Yu's Conquest of Southern Yan, was a military campaign launched by the Jin dynasty (266–420) against the Southern Yan dynasty during the Sixteen Kingdoms period of Chinese history. It was the first of two northern expeditions launched by the Jin general, Liu Yu, and resulted in the fall of Southern Yan.

zh.s: 晋灭南燕之战，又称刘裕灭南燕之战，是中国历史上十六国时期，东晋对南燕发动的一场军事行动。此次战役是东晋将领刘裕发动的两次北伐中的第一次，最终南燕灭亡。

en.t: A copy of the Diamond Sūtra is published, the earliest dated and printed book known
en.s: The Diamond Sūtra (Sanskrit: Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra) is a Mahāyāna Buddhist sutra from the genre of Prajñāpāramitā ('perfection of wisdom') sutras. Translated into a variety of languages over a broad geographic range, the Diamond Sūtra is one of the most influential Mahayana sutras in East Asia, and it is particularly prominent within the Chan (or Zen) tradition, along with the Heart Sutra.

zh.t: 《金刚经》刊印，成为已知最早有确切刊印日期的印刷书籍
zh.s: 《金刚经》（梵语：Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra）是一部大乘佛教经文，属于般若经类，主题为“般若”（智慧圆满）。《金刚经》已被译成多种语言，在广阔地域流传，是东亚影响最大的般若经之一，在禅宗传统中尤其重要，常与《心经》并列。

en.t: In the first coronation ceremony ever held for an English monarch, Edgar the Peaceful is crowned King of England, having ruled since 959 AD. His wife, Ælfthryth, is crowned queen, the first recorded coronation for a Queen of England
en.s: Edgar (or Eadgar; c. 944 – 8 July 975), also known as Edgar the Peaceful, the Peacemaker and the Peaceable, was King of the English from 959 until his death in 975. He became king of all England on his brother Eadwig's death. He was the younger son of King Edmund I and his first wife, Ælfgifu.

zh.t: 埃德加“和平者”加冕英格兰国王
zh.s: 埃德加（或称 Eadgar；约 944 年—975 年 7 月 8 日）又称“和平者”“缔造和平者”或“平和者”，自 959 年起担任英格兰国王，直至去世。兄长埃德维格去世后，他成为全英格兰的国王。他是埃德蒙一世与其第一任妻子埃尔夫吉富的小儿子。

en.t: Matilda of Flanders, wife of William the Conqueror, is crowned Queen of England
en.s: Matilda of Flanders (French: Mathilde; Dutch: Mathilde; German: Mechtild) (died 2 November 1083) was the daughter of Baldwin V, the Count of Flanders. She became Duchess of Normandy by marriage to William the Conqueror, and regent of Normandy during his absences from the duchy, when William was on campaign in England. Two years after William conquered England she was crowned Queen of England.

zh.t: 征服者威廉的妻子佛兰德的玛蒂尔达加冕为英格兰王后
zh.s: 佛兰德的玛蒂尔达（法语和荷兰语名均为Mathilde，德语名为Mechtild；1083年11月2日去世）是佛兰德伯爵鲍德温五世之女。她嫁给征服者威廉后成为诺曼底公爵夫人。威廉在英格兰征战期间，她曾担任诺曼底摄政。威廉征服英格兰两年后，她加冕为英格兰王后。

en.s: The Third Crusade (1189–1192) was an attempt led by King Philip II of France, King Richard I of England, and Emperor Frederick Barbarossa to reconquer the Holy Land following the capture of Jerusalem by the Ayyubid sultan Saladin in 1187. For this reason, the Third Crusade is also known as the Kings' Crusade. The Crusade was partially successful.

zh.s: 第三次十字军东征（1189—1192年）由法国国王腓力二世、英格兰国王理查一世和神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨领导，目标是在1187年阿尤布王朝苏丹萨拉丁攻占耶路撒冷后重新夺回圣地，因此也称“诸王十字军”。这次东征取得了部分成功。

en.s: The Treaty of Corbeil was an agreement signed on 11 May 1258, in Corbeil (today Corbeil-Essonnes, in the region of Île-de-France) between Louis IX of France and James I of Aragon. The French king, as the heir of Charlemagne, renounced the claims of feudal overlordship over the counties historiographically known as the Hispanic March, that is the part of the March of Gothia which remained within the geographical area known from the 12th century onwards as Catalonia.

zh.s: 科尔贝伊条约于1258年5月11日在科尔贝伊（今法兰西岛大区埃松河畔科尔贝伊）签署，签约双方是法国国王路易九世和阿拉贡国王海梅一世。作为查理曼大帝的继承人，法国国王放弃对史学上称为西班牙边区的各伯国所主张的封建宗主权。这片地区是哥特边区的一部分，自12世纪以来归属加泰罗尼亚地理范围。

en.s: The Battle of Kotesashi (小手指ヶ原の戦い, Kotesashi-gahara no tatakai) was part of the decisive Kōzuke-Musashi Campaign during the Genkō War in Japan that ultimately ended the Kamakura Shogunate. Fought in present-day Tokorozawa, Saitama on May 11, 1333, it pitted the anti-shogunate imperial forces led by Nitta Yoshisada against the pro-Shogunate forces of the Hōjō Regency led by Sakurada Sadakuni.

zh.s: 小手指之战（日语：小手指ヶ原の戦い，Kotesashi-gahara no tatakai）发生于1333年5月11日，是元弘之乱期间上野—武藏战役的关键一战，最终导致镰仓幕府灭亡。战斗发生在今天埼玉县所泽市，交战双方是新田义贞率领的反幕府朝廷军和樱田贞国率领的北条执权家幕府军。

zh.s: 明朝入越（中文：明入越／平定交南；越南称明—大虞战争，繁体中文：大虞與明戰爭；简体中文：大虞与明战争；越南语：Chiến tranh Đại Ngu–Đại Minh／cuộc xâm lược của nhà Minh 1406–1407；汉喃文：戰爭大虞 – 大明）是明朝对胡朝统治下的大虞王国（今越南北部）发动的一场军事行动。

en.s: The Battle of Torches (Turkish: Meşaleler Savaşı) was fought in 1583 during the Ottoman–Safavid War (1578–1590). The name of the battle refers to the torches used during night clashes. The battle resulted in an Ottoman victory, thereby securing Dagestan and Shirvan until the end of the war.

zh.s: 火把节战役（土耳其语：Meşaleler Savaşı）发生于1583年奥斯曼—萨法维战争（1578—1590年）期间。战役名称来自夜间交战时使用的火把。奥斯曼帝国在战役中获胜，并因此在战争结束前控制了达吉斯坦和设尔凡。

en.s: The Battle of Bantry Bay was on 11 May 1689, a week before the declaration of the Nine Years' War between the English and French navies. The English were commanded by Admiral Arthur Herbert, while the French were under the command of François Louis Rousselet de Châteaurenault. Apart from the inshore operations during the siege of La Rochelle, the battle was the first time English and French navies had fought a fleet action since 1545.

zh.s: 班特里湾海战于1689年5月11日爆发，距英法之间正式宣战九年战争还有一周。英军由亚瑟·赫伯特海军上将指挥，法军由弗朗索瓦-路易·鲁塞莱·德·沙托雷诺指挥。除拉罗谢尔围城战期间的近岸行动外，这是1545年以来英法海军首次进行舰队交战。

en.s: The Battle of Helsinki (Russian: Битва на реке Хельсинки) was fought between the Russian army under Tsar Peter the Great and Admiral Fyodor Apraksin and the defending Finnish army of Sweden under General Carl Gustaf Armfeldt between 8 and 11 May 1713, as part of the Great Northern War. It resulted in a Russian victory, leading to the Swedes commanded by Armfelt burning the entire city of Helsinki when retreating.

zh.s: 赫尔辛基战役（俄语：Битва на реке Хельсинки）于1713年5月8日至11日进行，是大北方战争的一部分。交战双方是彼得大帝和费奥多尔·阿普拉克辛海军上将率领的俄军，以及卡尔·古斯塔夫·阿姆费尔特将军指挥的瑞典芬兰守军。俄军获胜，阿姆费尔特率领的瑞典军撤退时焚毁了赫尔辛基全城。

en.s: The Battle of Fontenoy, 11 May 1745, was a major engagement of the War of the Austrian Succession, fought between the forces of the Pragmatic Allies – comprising mainly Dutch, British, and Hanoverian troops under the command of the Duke of Cumberland – and a French army under Maurice de Saxe, commander of King Louis XV's forces in the Low Countries. The battle was one of the most important in the war and considered the masterpiece of Saxe, serving France; Louis XV, and his son, the Dauphin, were present at the battle.

zh.s: 丰特努瓦战役于1745年5月11日爆发，是奥地利王位继承战争中的一场重要战役。交战双方是务实同盟军（主要由荷兰、英国和汉诺威部队组成，由坎伯兰公爵指挥）和法国军队；法军由路易十五派驻低地国家的指挥官莫里斯·德·萨克斯率领。该战役是战争中最重要的战役之一，也被视为萨克斯的代表作。路易十五及其儿子王太子也亲临战场。

en.s: The Battle of Courtrai (11 May 1794) saw a Republican French army under Jean-Charles Pichegru oppose Coalition forces commanded by François Sébastien Charles Joseph de Croix, Count of Clerfayt. The battle was fought as part of French efforts to defeat an Allied attempt to recapture Courtrai, which the French captured in the opening days of their 1794 offensive in the Low Countries.

zh.s: 科特赖克战役于1794年5月11日爆发，让-夏尔·皮舍格鲁率领的法兰西共和国军队与弗朗索瓦-塞巴斯蒂安·夏尔·约瑟夫·德·克鲁瓦伯爵指挥的联军交战。此战属于法军阻止盟军重新夺回科特赖克的行动；法军于1794年低地国家攻势初期攻占了该城。

en.s: The Battle of Puerto Plata Harbor took place in 1800 with France and Spain on one side, and the United States on the other, during the undeclared Quasi-War officially between the French First Republic and the United States. American forces landed about a hundred troops and sailors from USS Sally in Puerto Plata and boarded the French corvette Sandwich anchored there, which surrendered after a brief firefight.

zh.s: 1800年，美法准战争期间，法国和西班牙与美国在普拉塔港湾交战。美国从“莎莉号”军舰派出约100名水兵和陆战队员登陆普拉塔港，登上停泊在当地的法国轻型护卫舰“桑威奇号”。双方短暂交火后，法舰投降。

en.s: The Battle of Grijó (Portuguese pronunciation: [ɡɾiˈʒɔ]) (10–11 May 1809) ended in victory for the Anglo-Portuguese Army commanded by Lieutenant-General Sir Arthur Wellesley (the future 1st Duke of Wellington) over the French army commanded by Marshal Nicolas Soult during the Second French invasion of Portugal in the Peninsular War. The next day, Wellesley drove Soult from Porto in the Second Battle of Porto.

zh.s: 格里若战役（葡萄牙语发音：[ɡɾiˈʒɔ]）于1809年5月10日至11日结束，英葡联军在阿瑟·韦尔斯利中将（后来的第一代威灵顿公爵）指挥下，击败了尼古拉·苏尔特元帅指挥的法军。这场战役发生在半岛战争期间法国第二次入侵葡萄牙之时。次日，韦尔斯利在第二次波尔图战役中将苏尔特赶出了波尔图。

en.s: Spencer Perceval, the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, was shot and killed in the lobby of the House of Commons in London, at about 5:15 pm on Monday 11 May 1812. His assailant was John Bellingham, a Liverpool merchant with a grievance against the government. Bellingham was detained and, four days after the murder, was tried, convicted and sentenced to death.

zh.t: 斯潘塞·珀西瓦尔遇刺案
zh.s: 1812年5月11日（星期一）下午约5时15分，英国及爱尔兰联合王国首相斯潘塞·珀西瓦尔在伦敦下议院大厅遭枪击身亡。行凶者是利物浦商人约翰·贝林汉姆，他对政府心怀不满。贝林汉姆被捕，并于谋杀案发生四天后受审、被判有罪并判处死刑。

en.s: Spencer Perceval (1 November 1762 – 11 May 1812) was Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from October 1809 until his assassination in May 1812. He is the only British prime minister to have been assassinated, and the only solicitor-general or attorney-general to have become prime minister. The younger son of The Earl of Egmont, an Anglo-Irish earl, Perceval was educated at Harrow School and Trinity College, Cambridge.

zh.t: 斯宾塞·珀西瓦尔遇刺身亡
zh.s: 斯宾塞·珀西瓦尔（1762年11月1日—1812年5月11日）于1809年10月至1812年5月担任英国首相，后遭刺杀身亡。他是唯一一位遇刺身亡的英国首相，也是唯一一位曾任检察总长或副检察长并后来成为首相的人。珀西瓦尔是埃格蒙特伯爵（爱尔兰裔英国伯爵）的幼子，曾就读于哈罗公学和剑桥大学三一学院。

en.s: The Battle of Zacatecas in 1835 took place on 11 May 1835 in the immediate vicinity of the capital city in the state of Zacatecas, Mexico, between elements of the federal army under the command of Gen. Antonio López de Santa Anna and elements of the rebel army, which was commanded by General Francisco García Salinas during the Rebellion in Zacatecas of 1835.

zh.s: 1835年萨卡特卡斯战役于1835年5月11日在墨西哥萨卡特卡斯州首府附近爆发，交战双方是安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德·圣安纳将军率领的联邦军和弗朗西斯科·加西亚·萨利纳斯将军指挥的叛军。这场战役属于1835年萨卡特卡斯叛乱的一部分。

en.s: The Standoff at the Khyber Pass (1834–1835) was a short conflict from May 1834 to May 1835 between the Sikh forces led by Maharaja Ranjit Singh and the Afghan forces led by Dost Mohammad Khan. The conflict began as the Sikh Empire expanded into Peshawar, deposing the Peshawar Sardars, while also supporting the deposed Durrani dynasty in their attempts to return to the throne of Afghanistan under Shah Shuja Durrani.

zh.s: 开伯尔山口对峙（1834—1835年）是1834年5月至1835年5月间的一场短暂冲突，交战双方是兰吉特·辛格大君率领的锡克军队和多斯特·穆罕默德汗率领的阿富汗军队。冲突起因是锡克帝国向白沙瓦扩张，废黜当地萨达尔，同时支持被废黜的杜兰尼王朝试图在沙阿·舒贾·杜兰尼领导下重返阿富汗王位。

en.s: The Meerut mutiny was a military mutiny on 10 and 11 May 1857 in the city of Meerut in British-controlled India, the first significant armed action against British military authority which accelerated an outbreak of the Indian rebellion of 1857 and 1858. Most of the Indian native soldiers of whole city garrison, outraged by a severe punishment of their 85 other comrades, raised their weapons against the local British forces and eventually civilians in the city.

zh.s: 密拉特兵变于1857年5月10日至11日在英属印度的密拉特市发生，是反抗英国军事统治的首起重大武装行动，并加速了1857至1858年印度起义爆发。驻军中大多数印度本土士兵因85名同袍遭受严厉惩罚而愤怒，遂拿起武器反抗当地英军，后来也袭击了城中平民。

en.t: Defence of the Magazine at Delhi
en.s: The Defence of the Magazine at Delhi was an action of 11 May 1857 during the Indian Mutiny in which nine British soldiers of the East India Company defended the magazine at Delhi from rebelling sepoys. After more than four hours fighting against hundreds of attackers, and in order to deny the munitions to the enemy, the British defenders detonated the magazine, themselves with it.

zh.s: 德里军火库保卫战是1857年印度民族起义期间的一场战斗，发生于5月11日。东印度公司九名英国士兵守卫德里的军火库，抵挡起义的印度士兵。面对数百名进攻者，守军奋战四个多小时。为了不让弹药落入敌手，英国守军引爆军火库，自己也与军火库一同葬身爆炸。

en.s: Elections were held in the colony of Queensland between 27 April 1860 to 11 May 1860 to elect all 26 members of the colony's Legislative Assembly. It was conducted in nine single-member constituencies, four two-member constituencies, and three three-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system. Suffrage was limited to men who owned property. The electorates were also malapportioned to favour pastoral districts.

zh.s: 1860年4月27日至5月11日，昆士兰殖民地举行选举，选出殖民地立法议会全部26名议员。选举在9个单议席选区、4个双议席选区和3个三议席选区举行，均采用简单多数制。只有拥有财产的男性有选举权。选区划分也存在不均，偏向牧业地区。

en.s: The Battle of Yellow Tavern was fought on May 11, 1864, as part of the Overland Campaign of the American Civil War. Union cavalry under Maj. Gen. Philip Sheridan was detached from the Army of the Potomac to conduct a raid on Richmond, Virginia, and challenge legendary Confederate cavalry commander Maj. Gen. J.E.B. Stuart.

zh.s: 黄酒馆战役于1864年5月11日爆发，是美国内战陆上战役的一部分。菲利普·谢里登少将率领的联邦骑兵脱离波托马克军团，突袭弗吉尼亚州里士满，并挑战传奇的邦联骑兵指挥官J·E·B·斯图尔特少将。

en.s: The 1877 Victorian colonial election was held on 11 May 1877 to elect the 9th Parliament of Victoria. It was the first election in Victoria in which all electorates voted on the same day. All 86 seats in 55 electorates in the Legislative Assembly were up for election, though four seats were uncontested. There were 31 single-member, 20 two-member and 5 three-member electorates.

zh.s: 维多利亚殖民地于1877年5月11日举行选举，选出第九届维多利亚议会。这是维多利亚殖民地首次所有选区在同一天投票。立法议会55个选区的全部86席均须改选，其中四席没有竞争者。选区中有31个单一议席选区、20个双议席选区和5个三议席选区。

en.s: The Hödel assassination attempt, or the assassination attempt on Wilhelm I of 11 May 1878, was an armed attack carried out by Max Hödel, a young German anarchist, against the Kaiser, Wilhelm I. Along with the Nobiling assassination attempt, less than a month later and aimed at the same target, it was one of the first acts of propaganda by the deed in history.

zh.t: 赫德尔刺杀威廉一世未遂案
zh.s: 赫德尔刺杀未遂案又称1878年5月11日威廉一世遇刺案。德国青年无政府主义者马克斯·赫德尔持枪袭击了德皇威廉一世。不到一个月后，诺比林也以德皇为目标发动刺杀未遂案；这两起事件被视为历史上最早的一批“以行动宣传”袭击。

en.t: Seven people are killed in the Mussel Slough Tragedy, a gun battle in California
en.s: The Mussel Slough Tragedy was a shootout over disputed land titles between settlers and the Southern Pacific Railroad (SP). It took place on May 11, 1880, on a farm located 5.6 miles (9 km) northwest of Hanford, California, in the central San Joaquin Valley. Seven people were killed. The episode became a major theme in many protests and publications denouncing the railroads as villains in California history.

zh.t: 穆塞尔斯劳悲剧：加利福尼亚枪战造成七人死亡
zh.s: 穆塞尔斯劳悲剧是一场因土地所有权争议引发的枪战，交战双方是定居者和南太平洋铁路公司。事件发生于1880年5月11日，地点在加利福尼亚州汉福德西北约5.6英里（9公里）的一处农场，位于圣华金谷中部。共有七人死亡。这起事件后来成为许多抗议活动和出版物的重要主题，这些抗议和出版物将铁路公司谴责为加利福尼亚历史中的恶势力。

en.s: The Wham Paymaster robbery ( WHAHM) was an armed robbery of a United States Army paymaster and his escort on May 11, 1889, in the Arizona Territory. Major Joseph W. Wham was transporting a payroll consisting of more than US$28,000 (equivalent to $1,003,330 in 2025) in gold and silver coins from Fort Grant to Fort Thomas when he and his escort of eleven Buffalo Soldiers were ambushed.

zh.s: 惠姆军饷押运队劫案（WHAHM）是1889年5月11日发生在亚利桑那领地的一起武装劫案，目标是美国陆军军饷官及其护卫。约瑟夫·W·惠姆少校当时正把超过2.8万美元的金银币军饷（按2025年币值约合1,003,330美元）从格兰特堡运往托马斯堡。他和由11名布法罗士兵组成的护卫队途中遭到伏击。

en.s: The Pullman Strike was a nationwide railroad strike in the United States on May 11, 1894 and a turning point for US labor law. It pitted the American Railway Union (ARU) against the Pullman Company, the main railroads, and the federal government of the United States under President Grover Cleveland. The strike and boycott shut down much of the nation's freight and passenger traffic west of Detroit, Michigan. The conflict began in Pullman, Chicago, on May 11 when nearly 4,000 factory employees of the Pullman Company began a wildcat strike in response to recent reductions in wages.

zh.s: 普尔曼大罢工于1894年5月11日在美国爆发，是美国劳工法发展史上的转折点。美国铁路工会与普尔曼公司、各大铁路公司和格罗弗·克利夫兰总统领导的联邦政府对峙。罢工和抵制行动使底特律以西的大部分货运和客运交通停摆。5月11日，芝加哥普尔曼公司的近4,000名工人因近期减薪而自行发起罢工，冲突由此开始。

en.s: The 1897 Quebec general election was held on May 11, 1897, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Quebec, Canada. The Quebec Liberal Party, led by Félix-Gabriel Marchand, defeated the incumbent Quebec Conservative Party, led by Edmund James Flynn. This marked the start of over 39 consecutive years in power for the Liberals.

zh.s: 魁北克省于1897年5月11日举行大选，选出加拿大魁北克省立法议会议员。菲利克斯-加布里埃尔·马尔尚领导的魁北克自由党击败了埃德蒙·詹姆斯·弗林领导的执政魁北克保守党。自由党由此开始连续执政超过39年。

en.s: The Second Battle of Cárdenas was a secondary naval engagement of the Spanish–American War fought on 11 May 1898 in the port of Cárdenas, Cuba, between an American squadron of 5 ships under Captain Chapman C. Todd and 3 small Spanish vessels under Mariano Mateu. The battle resulted in an unusually costly American reverse that dissuaded the U.S. Navy from undertaking further attacks on the port.

zh.s: 第二次卡德纳斯战役是美西战争期间的一场次要海战，于1898年5月11日在古巴卡德纳斯港爆发。查普曼·C·托德上校率领的美国五艘舰艇编队与马里亚诺·马特乌指挥的三艘西班牙小型船只交战。美国方面伤亡异常惨重并遭到挫败，这使美国海军不再对该港发动攻击。

en.s: The Battle of Cienfuegos, also known as the Raid on Cienfuegos, was an engagement of the Spanish–American War, intended by the United States Navy to tighten its blockade of Cuba.

zh.s: 西恩富戈斯战役也称西恩富戈斯袭击，是美西战争期间的一次战斗。美国海军发动这次行动，意在加强对古巴的封锁。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 27 April and 11 May 1902. These elections were a victory for the Bloc des gauches alliance between Socialists, Radicals, and the left wing of the Republicans, over the anti-Dreyfusard right wing of the Republicans, the progressistes. The Bloc des gauches had been brought together to support the "Republican Defense Cabinet" (gouvernement de défense républicaine) formed by Pierre Waldeck-Rousseau following the assault on the newly elected President, Émile Loubet, on the Longchamp Racecourse on 4 June 1899, during the Dreyfus affair. However, Waldeck-Rousseau's own supporters (the ARD) took few seats in the election compared to the Radicals and Socialists.

zh.s: 法国于1902年4月27日和5月11日举行立法选举。由社会主义者、激进派和共和党左翼组成的左翼联盟击败了反德雷福斯派共和党右翼进步派，赢得选举。左翼联盟成立，是为了支持皮埃尔·瓦尔德克-卢梭组建的“共和防卫内阁”。该内阁于1899年德雷福斯事件期间、埃米尔·卢贝总统在朗尚赛马场遭袭后成立。不过，瓦尔德克-卢梭的支持者共和民主联盟在选举中赢得的席位远少于激进派和社会主义者。

en.s: The Battle of Carraleva Pass (Albanian: Beteja e Carralevës) was a battle between Albanian rebels and Ottoman forces during the Albanian revolt of 1910. Shevket Turgut Pasha launched an attack against Albanian rebels who were blocking the Carraleva Pass. After three days of fighting, the Albanian rebels repelled the Ottoman army. After the initial battle, the Ottoman army, aided by local Serbs who knew a shortcut over the mountains, nearly encircled the Albanian rebels in Carraleva.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 卡拉列瓦山口战役（阿尔巴尼亚语：Beteja e Carralevës）是1910年阿尔巴尼亚起义期间，阿尔巴尼亚叛军与奥斯曼军队之间的一场战斗。谢夫凯特·图尔古特帕夏率军进攻堵在卡拉列瓦山口的阿尔巴尼亚叛军。经过三天战斗，叛军击退了奥斯曼军队。首次交战后，熟悉山间捷径的当地塞尔维亚人协助奥斯曼军队绕行，叛军在卡拉列瓦一度险遭包围。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Flinders on 11 May 1918. This was triggered by the resignation of Nationalist MP Sir William Irvine to become Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Victoria. The Victorian Farmers' Union withdrew their candidate after extracting a promise from the Nationalist government to introduce preferential voting, although his name remained on the ballot paper.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院弗林德斯选区于1918年5月11日举行补选。国家党议员威廉·欧文爵士辞职出任维多利亚州最高法院首席大法官，因此触发补选。维多利亚农民联盟在国家党政府承诺引入偏好投票后撤回候选人，但候选人姓名仍留在选票上。

en.s: Battle of Kaniv, or Battle of Kaniów took place during World War I on the night of 10–11 May 1918, near Kaniv, Ukraine (Ukrainian: Канів, Polish: Kaniów) between Polish and German army troops. The fighting pitted the Polish II Corps in Russia (including Brigade II of the Polish Legions), under General Józef Haller von Hallenburg, against the German Imperial Army (including the 28th Landwehr Brigade), under General Franz Hermann Zierold.

zh.s: 卡尼夫战役（又称卡尼夫之战）发生于第一次世界大战期间，1918年5月10日至11日夜间，地点在乌克兰卡尼夫附近。交战双方是波兰军队和德国军队。由约瑟夫·哈勒·冯·哈伦堡将军指挥的驻俄波兰第二军（包括波兰军团第二旅），与弗朗茨·赫尔曼·齐罗尔德将军指挥的德意志帝国陆军（包括第28后备旅）交战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 11 May 1919. The three main parties that boycotted the 1918 elections returned to contest the elections. The result was a victory for the Democratic Party, which won 86 of the 163 seats in the House of Representatives and 36 of the 71 seats in the Senate.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1919年5月11日举行议会选举。曾抵制1918年选举的三大政党重新参选。民主党获胜，在众议院163席中赢得86席，在参议院71席中赢得36席。

en.s: The Battle of Bagh was fought between British and Afghan forces in British India's Northwest Frontier during the Third Anglo-Afghan War. On 3 May 1919, British troops suffered a setback in the northern theatre when Afghan forces captured the town of Bagh in Landi Kotal. Despite efforts to reinforce and launch a counterattack, the British failed to recapture Bagh on 9 May 1919.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 巴格战役发生在第三次英阿战争期间，交战双方是英属印度西北边境地区的英军和阿富汗军队。1919年5月3日，阿富汗军队在北部战场占领兰迪科塔尔的巴格镇，英军因此受挫。英军虽试图增援并发动反攻，但未能在1919年5月9日夺回巴格。

en.t: Uruguay becomes a signatory to the Buenos Aires copyright treaty
en.s: Uruguay, officially the Oriental Republic of Uruguay, is a country in southeastern South America. It shares borders with Argentina to its west and southwest and Brazil to its north and northeast, while bordering the Río de la Plata to the south and the Atlantic Ocean to the southeast. It is part of the Southern Cone region of South America.

zh.t: 乌拉圭加入《布宜诺斯艾利斯版权公约》
zh.s: 乌拉圭，正式名称为乌拉圭东岸共和国，是南美洲东南部的国家。该国西部和西南部与阿根廷接壤，北部和东北部与巴西接壤，南临拉普拉塔河，东南濒临大西洋，属于南美洲南锥体地区。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 11 May and 25 May 1924. They resulted in a victory for the left-wing Cartel des Gauches, an alliance of Radicals and Socialists, which governed until July 1926 under the premierships of Édouard Herriot, Paul Painlevé and Aristide Briand.

en.s: The Jinan incident (traditional Chinese: 濟南慘案; simplified Chinese: 济南惨案; Japanese: 済南事件; formerly romanised Tsinan) or 3 May Tragedy (traditional Chinese: 五三慘案; simplified Chinese: 五三惨案; pinyin: Wǔsān Cǎn'àn) began as a 3 May 1928 dispute between Chiang Kai-shek's National Revolutionary Army (NRA) and Japanese soldiers and civilians in Jinan, the capital of Shandong province in China, which then escalated into an armed conflict between the NRA and the Imperial Japanese Army.

zh.s: 济南惨案（繁体中文：濟南慘案；简体中文：济南惨案；日语：済南事件；旧罗马字拼法：Tsinan），又称“五三惨案”（繁体中文：五三慘案；简体中文：五三惨案；拼音：Wǔsān Cǎn'àn），起于1928年5月3日蒋介石领导的国民革命军与日本军民在中国山东省省会济南发生的一场争端，随后升级为国民革命军与日本帝国陆军之间的武装冲突。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 11 May 1929 to elect the 72 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. In this election, Irene Longman became the first woman to both stand and be elected into the Queensland Parliament. The Labor government was seeking its sixth continuous term in office since the 1915 election; it would be Premier William McCormack's second election.

zh.s: 澳大利亚昆士兰州于1929年5月11日举行选举，改选州立法议会全部72名议员。本次选举中，艾琳·朗曼成为首位参加昆士兰议会选举并成功当选的女性。自1915年选举以来一直执政的工党政府争取第六个连续任期；这是州长威廉·麦科马克第二次参加州选举。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 11 May 1935 to elect the 62 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The Labor government of Premier William Forgan Smith was seeking a second term after having defeated the Country and Progressive National Party in the 1932 election. Labor received a significant swing and gained 13 seats.

zh.s: 澳大利亚昆士兰州于1935年5月11日举行选举，改选州立法议会全部62名议员。威廉·福根·史密斯领导的工党政府争取连任；该党在1932年选举中击败了乡村进步民族党。本次选举中，工党支持率显著上升，增加了13个席位。

en.s: The 1935 New South Wales state election was held on 11 May 1935. This election was for all of the 90 seats in the 31st New South Wales Legislative Assembly and was conducted in single member constituencies with compulsory preferential voting. The result of the election was: United Australia Party 38 seats Country Party 23 seats Australian Labor Party (NSW) 29 seats.

zh.s: 新南威尔士州于1935年5月11日举行选举，改选第三十一届立法议会全部90个席位。选举采用单一议席选区，并实行强制偏好投票。选举结果为：澳大利亚联合党38席、乡村党23席、澳大利亚工党（新南威尔士州）29席。

en.s: The Integralist Uprising (Portuguese: Levante Integralista) was a failed coup by the Brazilian Integralist Action (AIB) against the government of president Getúlio Vargas on 11 May 1938 during the Estado Novo in Brazil. The AIB was created due to the radicalization of politics following the successful Revolution of 1930, which had brought Vargas to power, and the 1932 Constitutionalist Revolution, which had undermined revolutionary politics in favor of political extremes.

zh.s: 整合主义者起义（葡萄牙语：Levante Integralista）是巴西整合主义行动党于1938年5月11日发动的一场未遂政变，目标是推翻新国家时期的热图利奥·瓦加斯政府。巴西整合主义行动党是在1930年革命成功、瓦加斯上台，以及1932年宪政革命发生后成立的；后者削弱了革命政治，推动政坛走向极端。

en.s: The 1938 Lower Hutt mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. The elections were held for the role of Mayor of Lower Hutt plus other local government positions including the nine borough councillors, also elected triennially. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method.

zh.s: 1938年下哈特市长选举是同年新西兰地方选举的一部分。选举产生下哈特市长和其他地方政府职位，包括9名区议员；这些职位也每三年改选一次。投票采用简单多数制。

en.s: The 1938 Auckland City mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. In 1938, elections were held for the Mayor of Auckland plus other local government positions including twenty-one city councillors. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method. The election saw incumbent mayor Sir Ernest Davis re-elected, increasing his majority in the process.

zh.s: 1938年奥克兰市长选举是新西兰当年地方选举的一部分。选举还选出21名市议员，采用简单多数制。现任市长欧内斯特·戴维斯成功连任，领先优势进一步扩大。

en.s: The 1938 Christchurch City mayoral election was held on 11 May. The incumbent, John Beanland of the Citizens' Association, failed to get the nomination by his party and the surgeon Dr. John Guthrie was nominated instead. The Labour Party nominated Robert Macfarlane. Both the Labour and conservative candidate had been members of Christchurch City Council for some years. Macfarlane narrowly won the mayoralty.

zh.s: 基督城1938年市长选举于5月11日举行。公民协会现任市长约翰·宾兰德未获党内提名，外科医生约翰·格思里获提名。工党提名罗伯特·麦克法兰。工党和保守党候选人此前都曾在基督城市议会任职多年。麦克法兰以微弱优势赢得市长选举。

en.s: The 1938 Invercargill mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method. Incumbent mayor John Miller sought a fourth consecutive term, the fifth in total, against deputy mayor Gordon Reed. Miller died on 20 September, resulting in a by-election in October.

zh.s: 1938年因弗卡吉尔市长选举是同年新西兰地方选举的一部分，投票采用简单多数制。现任市长约翰·米勒争取连续第四次、总计第五次当选，副市长戈登·里德向他发起挑战。米勒于9月20日去世，导致当地于10月举行补选。

en.s: The 1938 Wellington mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that year. In 1938, elections were held for the Mayor of Wellington plus other local government positions including fifteen city councillors. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method. The contest resulted in the re-election of incumbent Thomas Hislop who defeated his only competitor Charles Chapman of the Labour Party.

zh.s: 1938年惠灵顿市长选举是新西兰当年地方选举的一部分。选举还选出15名市议员，采用简单多数制。现任市长托马斯·希斯洛普击败工党候选人查尔斯·查普曼，成功连任。

en.s: The 1938 Dunedin mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. In 1938, elections were held for the Mayor of Dunedin plus other local government positions including twelve city councillors. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method. Edwin Cox, the incumbent Mayor, sought re-election for a third term, a feat never before achieved in Dunedin.

zh.s: 1938年达尼丁市长选举是同年新西兰地方选举的一部分。除市长外，选民还选出12名市议员。投票采用简单多数制。现任市长埃德温·考克斯争取连任第三届；此前从未有人在达尼丁市长选举中做到这一点。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Ében-Émael was a battle between Belgian and German forces that took place between 10 May and 11 May 1940, and was part of the Battle of Belgium and Fall Gelb, the German invasion of the Low Countries and France. An assault force of German paratroopers, Fallschirmjäger, was tasked with assaulting and capturing Fort Ében-Émael, a Belgian fortress whose strategic position and strong artillery emplacements dominated several important bridges over the Albert Canal.

zh.s: 埃本-埃马尔要塞战役于1940年5月10日至11日爆发，是比利时战役和“黄色方案”（德国入侵低地国家及法国）的一部分。德军空降猎兵部队奉命突袭并攻占埃本-埃马尔要塞。这座比利时要塞战略位置重要，炮兵阵地控制着阿尔贝运河上的多座重要桥梁。

The result was a clear victory for the SPD, who won an absolute majority of 106 seats in the Landtag with 48.4% of the vote.

zh.s: 北莱茵-威斯特法伦州于1980年5月11日举行选举，选出第九届州议会。即将卸任的政府由社会民主党（SPD）和自由民主党（FDP）联合组成，州长是约翰内斯·劳。社民党以48.4%的得票率赢得州议会106席中的绝对多数，取得明显胜利。

en.s: The Bradford City stadium fire occurred during a Football League Third Division match on Saturday 11 May 1985 at the Valley Parade stadium in Bradford, West Yorkshire, England, killing 56 spectators and injuring at least 265. The stadium was known for its antiquated design and facilities, which included the wooden roof of the main stand. Previous warnings had also been given about a major build-up of litter in the cavity below the stand.

zh.s: 1985年5月11日（星期六），英格兰西约克郡布拉德福德的山谷巡游球场在一场英格兰足球联赛丙级比赛期间发生火灾，造成56名观众死亡，至少265人受伤。球场设计和设施陈旧，看台主棚顶为木质结构。此前也有人警告，看台下方空腔积存了大量垃圾，可能造成严重隐患。

en.s: The election for the Members of the Senate was held in the Philippines on May 11, 1987. The Philippine Senate was re-instituted following the approval of a new constitution in 1987 restoring the bicameral Congress of the Philippines; earlier, a constitution was approved in 1973 that created a unicameral Batasang Pambansa (parliament) that replaced the bicameral Congress. The last Senate election prior to this was the 1971 election. The Lakas ng Bayan Coalition (LABAN) got 64.9% of the vote but won 22 out of 24 seats in the Senate; only two candidates from the Grand Alliance for Democracy won: former Secretary of Defense Juan Ponce Enrile and San Juan mayor Joseph Estrada, despite getting 26.6% of the vote.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1987年5月11日举行参议院选举。1987年新宪法获批、菲律宾两院制国会恢复后，参议院重新成立；此前1973年宪法设立了一院制的国民议会，取代两院制国会。上一次参议院选举是在1971年。人民力量联盟（LABAN）获得64.9%的选票并赢得24席中的22席。大民主联盟只有两名候选人当选：前国防部长胡安·庞塞·恩里莱和圣胡安市长约瑟夫·埃斯特拉达。尽管该联盟的得票率为26.6%，当选人数仍只有两人。

en.t: Klaus Barbie goes on trial in Lyon for war crimes committed during World War II
en.s: Niklaus Barbie (25 October 1913 – 25 September 1991) was a German officer of the Schutzstaffel and Sicherheitsdienst who worked in Vichy France during World War II. He became known as the "Butcher of Lyon" for having personally tortured prisoners—primarily Jews and members of the French Resistance—as the head of the Gestapo in Lyon.

zh.t: 克劳斯·巴比在里昂因二战期间犯下的战争罪受审
zh.s: 尼克劳斯·巴比（1913年10月25日—1991年9月25日）是德国党卫队和安全处官员，二战期间曾在维希法国任职。他曾任里昂盖世太保负责人，亲自折磨囚犯，主要受害者是犹太人和法国抵抗运动成员，因此被称为“里昂屠夫”。

en.s: Presidential and vice presidential elections, legislative elections and local elections were held in the Philippines on May 11, 1992. An estimated 80,000 candidates ran for 17,000 posts from the Presidency down to municipal councillors in the first general election under the 1987 Constitution. Even though she was permitted by the Constitution to run for a second term, President Corazon Aquino did not stand for re-election. Retired general Fidel Ramos of Lakas-NUCD won a six-year term as President of the Philippines by a small margin, narrowly defeating populist candidate Miriam Defensor Santiago of the People's Reform Party.

en.s: The senatorial election was held in the Philippines on May 11, 1992. This was the first general election (where all positions are contested) under the 1987 Philippine Constitution. An estimated 80,000 candidates ran for 17,000 posts from the presidency down to municipal councilors. Under the transitory provisions of the Philippine constitution, 24 senators were elected in this election. The first 12 senators who garnered the highest votes would have a 6 six-year term while the next 12 senators would have a 3-year term. Laban ng Demokratikong Pilipino (LDP) got a large share in the Senate race.

zh.s: 菲律宾参议员选举于1992年5月11日举行。这是1987年菲律宾宪法实施后的首次大选，所有职位均进行选举。估计有80,000名候选人角逐17,000个公职，从总统到市议员均在其列。根据宪法过渡条款，本次选举产生24名参议员。得票最高的前12名任期六年，其余12名任期三年。民主菲律宾人斗争党（LDP）在参议院选举中获得大量选票。

en.s: Triplemanía IV-A was a major lucha libre, or professional wrestling, show promoted by the Mexican-based Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA) and was the first of three Triplemanía IV shows held in 1996. The event took place on May 11, 1996 at the International Amphitheatre in Chicago, Illinois, United States and marked the first time AAA held a Triplemanía outside of Mexico and one of the few times Triplemanía was an international event. The annual Triplemanía show(s) are AAA's biggest show of the year, serving as the culmination of major storylines and feature wrestlers from all over the world competing in what has been described as AAA's version of WrestleMania or their Super Bowl event.

zh.s: Triplemanía IV-A是一场重要的自由式摔角赛事，由墨西哥摔角推广公司AAA主办，是1996年举行的三场Triplemanía IV赛事中的第一场。赛事于1996年5月11日在美国伊利诺伊州芝加哥的国际圆形剧场举行，是AAA首次在墨西哥境外举办Triplemanía，也是该系列少数几次走出墨西哥举办的赛事之一。Triplemanía是AAA每年的重头赛事，用来收束主要剧情线，并汇集来自世界各地的摔角选手，常被比作AAA版的摔角狂热或超级碗。

en.s: ValuJet Flight 592 was a regularly scheduled flight from Miami to Atlanta in the United States. On May 11, 1996, the McDonnell Douglas DC-9 operating the route crashed into the Florida Everglades about 10 minutes after departing Miami due to a fire in the cargo compartment. The fire was caused by mislabeled and improperly stored chemical oxygen generators. All 110 people on board were killed.

en.t: Deep Blue, a chess-playing supercomputer, defeats Garry Kasparov in the last game of the rematch, becoming the first computer to beat a world-champion chess player in a classic match format
en.s: Garry Kimovich Kasparov (born Garik Kimovich Weinstein on 13 April 1963) is a Russian chess grandmaster, political activist and writer, who was the World Chess Champion from 1985 to 2000. His peak FIDE chess rating of 2851, achieved in 1999, was the highest recorded until being surpassed by Magnus Carlsen in 2013. zh.s: 加里·金诺维奇·卡斯帕罗夫（1963年4月13日生，出生名加里克·金诺维奇·温斯坦）是俄罗斯国际象棋特级大师、政治活动家和作家，曾于1985年至2000年担任世界冠军。他在1999年创下2851分的最高国际棋联等级分，直到2013年才被马格努斯·卡尔森超越。1984年至2005年退出常规竞技比赛期间，他累计255个月位居世界第一，创下纪录。

en.t: Deep Blue defeated Garry Kasparov in six games to become the first chess computer to win a match against a world champion
en.s: Deep Blue was a customized IBM RS/6000 SP supercomputer for chess-playing designed by computer scientist Feng-hsiung Hsu. It was the first computer to win a game, and the first to win a match, against a reigning world champion under regular time controls. Development began in 1985 at Carnegie Mellon University under the name ChipTest. It then moved to IBM, where it was first renamed Deep Thought, then again in 1989 to Deep Blue.

zh.t: 深蓝以六局比赛击败加里·卡斯帕罗夫，成为首台在对弈中击败世界冠军的国际象棋计算机
zh.s: 深蓝是IBM定制的RS/6000 SP国际象棋超级计算机，由计算机科学家许峰雄设计。它是首台在常规时限下赢得现役世界冠军一局棋、并最终赢得整场比赛的计算机。研发于1985年在卡内基梅隆大学启动，项目最初名为ChipTest；之后转至IBM，先改名为“深思”，1989年又改名为“深蓝”。

en.t: K-1 World MAX 2002 World Tournament final
en.s: K-1 World MAX 2002 World Tournament Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 Organisation. It was the inaugural K-1 World MAX final for middleweight kickboxers (70 kg/154 lb weight class), consisting of eight finalists and two reserve fighters, with all bouts fought under K-1 rules. The tournament fighters had qualified via preliminary tournaments or had been invited due to their achievements in the world of kickboxing and Muay Thai (more information on the fighters is displayed by the bulleted list below). In total there were ten fighters at the event, representing seven countries. The tournament winner was Albert Kraus who defeated Kaolan Kaovichit by first round knockout to become the first ever K-1 MAX champion. Of the two fighters, Kraus had the tougher path to the final having had to beat Shane Chapman and home favourite Masato en route to the final. The event was held at the Nippon Budokan in Tokyo, Japan on Saturday, 11 May 2002.

en.s: The Central Somalia Spring Fighting of 2009 (May 11, 2009 – present) was a series of battles in Hiraan, Shabeellaha Dhexe and Galgudug between rebels of al-Shabaab and Hizbul Islam and government forces and ICU militants loyal to the government, during spring 2009 as well as pro-government militia of Ahlus Sunnah wal Jamaah. The fighting led to al-Shabaab capturing major government strongholds and Ethiopian forces re-entering Somalia and setting up bases in Hiraan. There was a halt in fighting during a government offensive in Mogadishu, which started on May 22.

zh.s: 2009年索马里中部春季战事于2009年5月11日开始，至今仍在持续。冲突发生在希兰、中谢贝利和加勒古杜德地区，交战双方是青年党和伊斯兰党叛军，以及政府军、效忠政府的伊斯兰法院联盟武装人员和亲政府的逊尼派组织民兵。战事导致青年党攻占多处政府重要据点，埃塞俄比亚军队重新进入索马里并在希兰设立基地。摩加迪沙政府军于5月22日发动攻势期间，战斗曾暂时停止。

en.s: On May 11, 2009, five United States military personnel were fatally shot at a military counseling clinic at Camp Liberty, Iraq by Army Sergeant John M. Russell. en.s: The 2011 Lorca earthquake (Spanish: Terremoto de Lorca de 2011) was a moderate magnitude 5.1 Mw earthquake that caused significant localized damage in the Region of Murcia, Spain. Centred at a very shallow depth of 1 km (0.6 mi) near the town of Lorca, it occurred at 18:47 CEST (16:47 UTC) on 11 May 2011, causing panic among locals and displacing many from their homes. The quake was preceded by a magnitude 4.4 (Mw) foreshock at 17:05 (15:05 UTC), that inflicted substantial damage to many older structures in the area, including the historical Espolón Tower of Lorca Castle, the Hermitage of San Clemente and the Convent of Virgen de Las Huertas.

zh.s: 2011年洛尔卡地震发生于2011年5月11日18:47（中欧夏令时；世界协调时16:47），震中位于西班牙穆尔西亚自治区洛尔卡镇附近，震源深度仅1公里（0.6英里），矩震级为5.1级。地震造成当地严重破坏，引发居民恐慌，许多人无家可归。此前17:05（世界协调时15:05）发生了一次4.4级前震，对当地多座老建筑造成严重破坏，包括洛尔卡城堡的历史建筑埃斯波隆塔、圣克莱门特隐修院和韦尔塔斯圣母修道院。

en.s: The Council of Europe Convention on Preventing and Combating Violence Against Women and Domestic Violence, better known as the Istanbul Convention, is a human rights treaty of the Council of Europe opposing violence against women and domestic violence which was opened for signature on 11 May 2011, in Istanbul, Turkey. en.s: On 11 May 2013, two car bombs exploded in the Turkish town of Reyhanlı, a town of 64,000 people, 5 km from the Syrian border and the busiest land border post with Syria, in Hatay Province, Turkey. At least 52 people were killed and 140 injured in the attack. Turkish authorities accused the government of Syria of being behind the bombings, and within two weeks had charged 12 Turkish nationals who it said were backed by the Syrian government.

en.s: The 2019 Sandakan by-election was a by-election held on 11 May 2019 for the Dewan Rakyat seat of Sandakan. It was called following the death of incumbent, Wong Tien Fatt on 28 March 2019. Wong was a 2-term Member of Parliament for Sandakan since 2013. He was a member and Sabah state party chairman (2015-2019) of the Democratic Action Party (DAP), a component party of the Pakatan Harapan (PH) coalition.

en.s: The 2019 National League play-off final, known as the Vanarama National League Promotion Final for sponsorship reasons, was a football match played at Wembley Stadium in London on 11 May 2019 to decide the second team to be promoted from the National League to EFL League Two for the 2019–20 season. zh.s: 2019年全国联赛升级附加赛决赛因赞助冠名为Vanarama全国联赛升级决赛，于2019年5月11日在伦敦温布利球场举行，决定哪支球队将成为第二支升入2019—20赛季英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛的队伍。这场决赛是2019年全国联赛附加赛的收官战，索尔福德城以3比0击败菲尔德，和全国联赛冠军莱顿东方一同升级。

en.s: The 2019 OFC Champions League final was the final match of the 2019 OFC Champions League, the 18th edition of the Oceanian Club Championship, Oceania's premier club football tournament organized by the Oceania Football Confederation (OFC), and the 13th season under the current OFC Champions League name. The final was contested as a single match between New Caledonian teams Magenta and Hienghène Sport. The match took place at the Stade Numa-Daly Magenta in Nouméa on 11 May 2019.

zh.s: 2019年大洋洲冠军联赛决赛是当年赛事的最后一场比赛，也是大洋洲俱乐部锦标赛第18届赛事。该赛事是大洋洲顶级俱乐部足球比赛，由大洋洲足球联合会（OFC）主办；这是现行“大洋洲冠军联赛”名称启用后的第13个赛季。决赛为单场比赛，由新喀里多尼亚球队马让塔对阵海恩根体育。比赛于2019年5月11日在努美阿的努马-达利马让塔体育场举行。

en.s: The 2019 Greek Cup final was the 75th final of the Greek Cup. It took place on 11 May 2019 at the Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were PAOK and AEK Athens for a third time in row. It was PAOK's twentieth Greek Cup final and third consecutive, in their 93 years of existence and AEK Athens' twenty fourth Greek Cup final and fourth consecutive, of their 95-year history.

zh.s: 2019年希腊杯决赛是第75届决赛，于2019年5月11日在奥林匹克体育场举行。对阵双方是塞萨洛尼基PAOK和雅典AEK，这是两队连续第三年在决赛中相遇。PAOK在队史93年间第二十次打进希腊杯决赛，也是连续第三年进入决赛；雅典AEK则在队史95年间第二十四次打进决赛，也是连续第四年进入决赛。

en.s: The 2019 European Rugby Champions Cup Final was the final match in the 2018–19 European Rugby Champions Cup, and the twenty-fourth European club rugby final in general. The final was between defending champions and four-time winners Leinster, and two-time winners Saracens. Saracens defeated Leinster to claim their third title, overcoming a ten-point deficit to tie the score at half-time, before taking the lead in the second half to secure victory with a final result of 20–10.

zh.s: 2019年欧洲橄榄球冠军杯决赛是2018—19赛季欧洲橄榄球冠军杯的决赛，也是欧洲俱乐部橄榄球赛事的第24场决赛。决赛由卫冕冠军、曾四次夺冠的伦斯特对阵曾两次夺冠的萨拉森人。萨拉森人以20比10击败伦斯特，第三次夺得冠军。他们在上半场一度落后10分，随后追平比分，并在下半场反超取胜。

en.s: The 2021 North Miami mayoral election took place on May 11, 2021. Incumbent Mayor Philippe Bien-Aime ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by Michael Etienne, the former city clerk. During the campaign, Etienne attacked Bien-Aime for fiscal irresponsibility and argued that it was "absolutely imperative" to rein in the city's budget deficit, while Bien-Aime attacked Etienne for mismanagement of the city clerk's office.

zh.s: 北迈阿密市长选举于2021年5月11日举行。现任市长菲利普·比安-艾梅竞选连任，争取第二个任期。前市书记迈克尔·埃蒂安向他发起挑战。竞选期间，埃蒂安批评比安-艾梅在财政管理上不负责任，称削减市预算赤字“绝对有必要”；比安-艾梅则指责埃蒂安管理市书记办公室不力。

en.s: The 2021 Omaha mayoral election was held in 2021. Incumbent Republican mayor Jean Stothert was re-elected to a third term in office. Stothert is the first person elected to a third consecutive term as mayor of Omaha in the modern era. The position of mayor in Omaha is officially a non-partisan position. A blanket primary was held on April 6, 2021.

zh.s: 2021年奥马哈市长选举于2021年举行。共和党籍现任市长珍·斯托瑟特成功连任，开始第三个任期。她是奥马哈进入现代时期以来首位连续当选三届市长的人。奥马哈市长一职在官方上不设党派。初选于2021年4月6日举行。

en.s: The 2021 Anchorage mayoral election was held on April 6, 2021, to elect the mayor of Anchorage, Alaska. As no candidate received at least 45% of the vote in the first round, the two candidates with the highest vote share, Forrest Dunbar and Dave Bronson, advanced to a runoff on May 11. The election was officially nonpartisan.

en.s: The Mon Taing Pin massacre was a mass killing of civilians by Burmese military forces on 11 May 2022, in the village of Mondaingbin, Sagaing Region, Myanmar. During the massacre, Myanmar Army troops executed at least 37 villagers. Sagaing Region later became the site of several additional mass killings perpetrated by the Burmese military, including the Letyetkon and Tadaing massacres.

zh.s: 蒙泰平大屠杀是缅甸军方于2022年5月11日在缅甸实皆省蒙丹宾村杀害平民的事件。缅甸军队在屠杀中处决至少37名村民。此后，实皆省还发生过多起缅甸军方实施的大规模杀戮，包括莱杰贡和达代大屠杀。

en.s: The 2022 Coppa Italia final decided the winners of the 2021–22 Coppa Italia, Italy's premier football cup, the Coppa Italia. It was played on 11 May 2022 between Juventus and Internazionale. Internazionale won the match 4–2 after extra time for their eighth Coppa Italia title. As winners, they qualified for the 2022 Supercoppa Italiana against the champions of the 2021–22 Serie A.

zh.s: 2022年匈牙利杯决赛决出了2021—22赛季匈牙利杯冠军，这是该国顶级足球杯赛第82个赛季。比赛于2022年5月11日举行，由费伦茨瓦罗斯对阵帕克斯。费伦茨瓦罗斯以3比0获胜，第二十四次夺得匈牙利杯冠军。

en.s: The Eurovision Song Contest 2024 was the 68th edition of the Eurovision Song Contest. It consisted of two semi-finals on 7 and 9 May and a final on 11 May 2024, held at the Malmö Arena in Malmö, Sweden, and presented by Petra Mede and Malin Åkerman. en.s: Operation Black Forest (also Operation Kagaar) was a counter-insurgency and counter-terrorism operation conducted by Indian security forces against Naxalite-Maoist insurgents in areas located between the states of Chhattisgarh and Telangana.
